cards.say: Value of the three in four million three hundred and five thousand six hundred and seventy two. three hundred thousand, three hundred thousand.
Value of the five in four million three hundred and five thousand six hundred and seventy two. five thousand, five thousand.
Value of the four in four million three hundred and five thousand six hundred and seventy two. four million, four million.

cards.front: How many thousands make one million?
cards.say: How many thousands make one million? one thousand. one thousand times one thousand equals one million.

cards.front: Write in digits: six million, forty thousand, eight hundred and five
cards.say: Write in digits: six million, forty thousand, eight hundred and five. six million forty thousand eight hundred and five

cards.back: Two million, fifty thousand, three hundred.
cards.say: Write two million fifty thousand three hundred in words. Two million, fifty thousand, three hundred.
What is nine hundred and ninety nine thousand nine hundred and ninety nine plus one? one million, one million.
Largest four digit number using three, nine, zero, five once each. nine thousand five hundred and thirty
Smallest four digit number using three, nine, zero, five once each. three thousand and fifty nine. The zero cannot go first.

cards.back: 4,600. The tens digit is 6, so round up.
cards.say: Round four thousand five hundred and sixty seven to the nearest one hundred. four thousand six hundred. The tens digit is six, so round up.

cards.back: 46,000. The hundreds digit is 6, so round up.
cards.say: Round forty five thousand six hundred and seventy eight to the nearest one thousand. forty six thousand. The hundreds digit is six, so round up.

cards.back: 300,000. The ten thousands digit is 4, so round down.
cards.say: Round three hundred and forty nine thousand nine hundred and ninety nine to the nearest one hundred thousand. three hundred thousand. The ten thousands digit is four, so round down.

cards.back: One tenth. There are 10 tenths in 1.
cards.say: zero point one is one what? One tenth. There are ten tenths in one.
zero point zero seven in words. Seven hundredths.

cards.front: In 3.482, what does the 4 stand for?
cards.back: 4 tenths (0.4). The 8 is 8 hundredths and the 2 is 2 thousandths.
cards.say: In three point four eight two, what does the four stand for? four tenths, zero point four. The eight is eight hundredths and the two is two thousandths.

cards.back: 0.5. Think of 0.50 and 0.45: 50 hundredths is more than 45 hundredths.
cards.say: Which is greater, zero point five or zero point four five? zero point five. Think of zero point five zero and zero point four five: fifty hundredths is more than forty five hundredths.
Order smallest to largest: zero point three, zero point zero three, zero point three three. zero point zero three, zero point three, zero point three three

cards.front: Round 3.67 to the nearest whole number
cards.back: 4. The tenths digit is 6, so round up.
cards.say: Round three point six seven to the nearest whole number. four. The tenths digit is six, so round up.

cards.back: 2.4. A 5 in the next place rounds up.
cards.say: Round two point three five to one decimal place. two point four. A five in the next place rounds up.
Four point six times one hundred. Four hundred and sixty. Digits move two places to the left.
Thirty five divided by one hundred. Zero point three five. Digits move two places to the right.
